card.name: Study design words in research summaries
card.fires_on: Small words and punctuation right before a study-type word (such as longitudinal, replicated, meta-analysis, or prospective) in abstracts and trial-registry descriptions of study design.

modes.label: Registry design field
modes.description: The colon after a study design heading such as Time Perspective, before a value like Prospective.

modes.label: Abstract of a study
modes.description: Linking words inside abstracts that describe studies, cohorts and change over time.

modes.label: Citation or study description
modes.description: A word in a title or methods line just before a design term like meta-analysis or randomized.
